svg.title: THE SAME POUR, CLOSER IN
svg.desc: Numbered observations on the October 7 photograph IMG_6278.JPG. Leveled concrete and exposed shaft reinforcement; Isolated circular shaft head within the concrete; Crew finishing the near edge of the pour; Worker at the edge, climbing out per observer; Access ladder at the southeast corner, per observer
